Cook.description: A member of the kitchen brigade. A first name alone is not an identity.

Dish.description: A dish on the menu, named by its title, independent of who cooks it.

Brigade.description:
Which post a cook holds on a dish: lead cooks it, plater plates it, prep prepares its parts ahead.
Plating a dish is not cooking it.

Rota.description: A standing tie between two cooks: one trained the other, or one relieves the other on shift.

Delivery.description: Produce coming in from a supplier. ordered_by placed the order, received_by took it in at the door, signed_by signed the docket.

Special.description: A dish offered off-menu for a service. status says proposed, on or off.

questions.q: Who is the lead on the lamb shoulder?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Dish)-[:lead]->(n1:Cook) WHERE n0.title = 'lamb shoulder' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Which dishes are plated by me?
questions.speaker: wayra
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Cook)-[:plated]->(n1:Dish) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.title AS title

questions.speaker: meenakshi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Cook)-[:trainer]->(n1:Cook) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
MATCH (n0:Cook)-[:trainee]->(n1:Cook) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Wayra Quispe' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.item = 'halibut' RETURN n0.chilled AS chilled

questions.q: Is there a record that the dairy order was chilled?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.item = 'dairy order' RETURN coalesce(n0.chilled, false) AS chilled

questions.q: Which deliveries did Zofia Mazur place?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Cook)<-[:ordered_by]-(n1:Delivery) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Zofia Mazur' RETURN n1.item AS item

questions.q: Who signed for the lamb carcasses?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delivery)-[:signed_by]->(n1:Cook) WHERE n0.item = 'lamb carcasses' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many crates of chanterelles came?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.item = 'chanterelles' RETURN n0.crates AS crates
MATCH (n0:Cook)-[:relief]->(n1:Cook) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Joaquim Bettencourt' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many portions of the plum tart special are there?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Dish)<-[:dish]-(n1:Special) WHERE n0.title = 'plum tart' RETURN n1.portions AS portions
MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.item = 'chanterelles' RETURN n0.supplier AS supplier

questions.q: What deliveries did I take in?
questions.speaker: joaquim
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Cook)<-[:received_by]-(n1:Delivery) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.item AS item
MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.item CONTAINS 'lamb' RETURN n0.item AS item

questions.q: What is the item and stage of every delivery?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delivery) RETURN n0.item AS item, n0.stage AS stage

questions.q: Is the saffron risotto special vegan?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Dish)<-[:dish]-(n1:Special) WHERE n0.title = 'saffron risotto' RETURN n1.vegan AS vegan
MATCH (n0:Dish)-[:prep]->(n1:Cook) WHERE n0.title = 'beet tartare' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
